rowTerms.text: Multiple terminals — every terminal is a card, a filtered view of one log

widths.text:
Size = the width of where a card sits; height = what its stack leaves
icon · tray (a terminal shows unread)
line · trail / strip row (a terminal is a ticker)
panel · 240 (channels, navigator, tree, streams)
unit · 352–450 (a chat sidecar, ~50 ch)
measure · ~704 (the primary, ~90 ch; a medium card)
stage · everything (full; the primary stays as a strip)

The primary terminal never closes or minimizes. Any filter can be primary: the room in chat, everything in explore.
Every terminal card carries its own command bar and input mode (barId).

rowPhone.text: Phone — chat first; one terminal, cards inline, switch don’t stack

phoneNotes.text:
Phone widths collapse to three: line (chips) · unit (a card inline, cut) · stage (a card as a sheet)

Chat: no button bar. Throughput help is the target chip (say ▾), the suggestion strip only while typing, a reply chip, and long-press for react / reply / tell / look — each showing its command.

Swipe right: the panel card (channels; the highlight = what the one terminal shows). Swipe left: who is here.

Explore: the button bar is the commands card at line size (exits first), above it the placed-card chips with the room first.

Mode tabs hide while the keyboard is up. Govern is not a tab yet.

rowInspect.text: Inspection card — rebuilt from the specimen sheet: real rows, real strings

inspectNotes.text:
Every line is what the server says today for that row, unless it is blue and italic: proposed, needing server work.

THE GUTTER (like the terminal's GutterStripe): every section has a 3px stripe in its source's color. Hover → tooltip (name, what the interface is, what it says, the commands); click → popover (help, the deeper look, copy). Sections are told apart by their stripes, not rules.
• solid = a mixin • dotted = a class's own augmenter (Character, Weapon, CraftVessel) or a look controller line • blue dashes = proposed
• several stripes side by side = several sources made one section (the description: Visible + Detailed)
• the header carries Perceptible (what you can call it) and Containable / Addressable (where it is)

QUIET: interfaces that said nothing collapse into one last row, “N quiet interfaces ▸”, which expands in place. The pill strip is gone.

SCROLL: the header never scrolls. Unit cuts to fit (bottom-up, with a “cut to fit … larger ▸” bar); medium and full scroll under the header.

IMAGES: one general picture per row, generated once from authored, stable state only; never runtime contents or people in places. The row declares its shape: wide 16:9 (full width at unit, a block at medium) · tall 4:5 (a column beside the description) · square (beside the description). The client never crops or stretches. No image is a valid answer.

Specimen sheet + traces: specimens/ beside these frames.

ladder.text:
Sizes
icon — you minimized it · tray at the right of the status bar
glance — the system shrank it (aged out, displaced, a room you left) · trail atop the card area
unit — portrait body · the card area, one column per unit
medium — landscape body · top of the terminal column
full — the stage · the terminal drops to a 4-line strip + command bar

Geometry (CSS px, zoom-aware)
nav rail 56 · mode panel 240 (collapses first)
terminal column 704 · text capped at 42rem
unit ≥ 352, stretches to fill · gaps 12
1 unit = feed (placed on top, flow below, newest at the bottom)
2+ units = workspace (placed cards hold slots, new cards land in the dashed slot)

Placeholders: branch marks are letters (L·A·T·I) until the icon set is designed; card bodies are bars.
